values: 滥好人又爱耍帅。虽然有着讨伐魔王的大义，但途中遇到有困难的人一定会伸出援手。
A hopeless do-gooder with a flair for the dramatic. Though driven by a grand quest to defeat the Demon King, he can never resist stopping to help anyone in need along the way.
得展现出帅气的一面才行啊。
I must show my handsome side.
看来，又要开始一段愉快的冒险了。
Seems we're headed for another good adventure.
真美啊……在我的故乡，也盛开着非常美丽的花朵。
Beautiful... just like the flowers back in my homeland.
唔，刚刚的姿势是不是帅过头了？
Too handsome to handle? Fine, I'll dial it back.
这是要给我的吗？我太开心了。
For me? Oh, you just made my day.
辛美尔最喜欢的食物是茹弗蛋包饭。
Himmel's favorite dish is l'oeuf omelette.
辛美尔对自己勇者的身份感到自豪，喜欢在旅行时绕远路。
Himmel wears the title of "hero" like a badge of honor, and if there's a longer road to take, you can bet he's taking it.
辛美尔是个发自内心享受冒险的天才，每到一个新地方都必须从头到尾、一处不落地探索完才罢休。
Himmel is a natural-born adventurer—the kind who has to explore every inch of a new place. If there's a cave, he's in it. If there's a hill, he's climbing it.
据说辛美尔在请人为他制作铜像时，曾为摆姿势纠结了整整18个小时，把工匠大叔气得暴跳如雷。
They say Himmel once spent eighteen full hours fussing over the perfect pose for his statue. By the end of it, the sculptor was ready to quit his job.
辛美尔故乡生长的苍月草会开出美丽的蓝色花朵，辛美尔对这种花有着特殊的感情。
In Himmel's homeland, blue-moon weeds bloom into stunning blue flowers—a sight that always tugs at his heart.
辛美尔的勇者之剑，是他小时候帮助过的行商为了表达感谢而赠送的复制品。
Himmel's so-called hero's sword is actually a replica, gifted by a traveling merchant he once helped as a child.
当看到芙莉莲施展绽放美丽花田的魔法时，辛美尔似乎第一次觉得魔法是如此美丽。
Frieren once made a barren field bloom with flowers before Himmel's eyes. That was the first time he was struck by how beautiful magic could be.
辛美尔拥有自己独创的帅气姿势合集。
Himmel keeps a personal collection of cool poses.
辛美尔有很强的正义感，遇见有困难的人决不会弃之不顾，也正因如此，勇者一行在讨伐魔王的旅程中总是绕远路。
Himmel can't walk past someone in trouble without stopping to help. That's why what should've been a straight march to slay the Demon King turned into a long, winding adventure.
当强敌出现时，辛美尔会召开作战会议。他能在吸纳同伴意见的同时，作出精准的指挥决策。
When a tough enemy shows up, Himmel gets the team together, hears everyone out, and always manages to make the right call.
